data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating TopOn Ads using Method Channels.
data.what_it_does: Integrates TopOn Ads into Flutter apps using Method Channels, supporting interstitial, rewarded, banner, native, and splash ads. Provides methods to initialize the SDK, load and show various ad formats, and listen to ad lifecycle events.
use_when: You need to monetize your Flutter app using the TopOn ad mediation platform
Your app requires interstitial, rewarded, banner, native, or splash ads on Android and iOS
avoid_when: You prefer pure Dart or widget-based ad integrations without native setup
You use an ad platform other than TopOn
strengths: Supports multiple ad formats including interstitial, rewarded, banner, native, and splash ads
Provides server-to-server (S2S) rewarded postback data support
Supports both Android and iOS platforms
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration on both Android and iOS (such as Podfile and Info.plist edits)
Uses Method Channels rather than a pure widget or platform-view abstraction for everything
data.setup_notes: Requires native SDK dependencies and permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, and CocoaPods adapter setup, App Tracking Transparency, and Info.plist keys on iOS.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want official Google AdMob and Ad Manager integration rather than the TopOn mediation platform.
